content.title: THE MINERAL MOST {{TIRED}} PEOPLE ARE SECRETLY SHORT ON
facts: **Iodine** (Thyroid Fuel) — Cod | Seaweed Snacks | Eggs | Prunes
**Potassium** (Heart Rhythm Keeper) — Butternut Squash | White Beans | Coconut Water | Swiss Chard
**Copper** (Energy Enzyme Helper) — Oysters | Cashew Butter | Shiitake Mushrooms | Dark Leafy Greens
**Manganese** (Bone Builder) — Mussels | Brown Rice | Pineapple | Pecans
**Selenium** (Cell Shield) — Brazil Nuts | Sardines | Sunflower Seeds | Brown Rice
**Zinc** (Wound Healer) — Hemp Seeds | Chickpeas | Turkey | Oats
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Iodine barely gets talked about, but your thyroid can't make its hormones without it — and those hormones set the pace for your metabolism, energy, and even body temperature. A couple servings of cod or a handful of seaweed snacks a week can go a long way. Copper is another quiet one: it helps your body form red blood cells and actually works alongside iron, so a copper gap can leave you feeling drained even if your iron looks fine. And manganese is one of those unsung minerals your bones and connective tissue lean on daily — a cup of pineapple or a small handful of pecans helps keep that supply steady. Everyone's body is different, listen to yours.
